name: CRACK≡TRICK!
source:
In the near future, a time when cyberization has become commonplace,

the protagonist Hayate Kisaragi, a graduate of the prestigious educational institution [Academy] known for producing exceptional talent,
runs a detective agency in his hometown, despite graduating at the top of his class and having no interest in status or fame.

Seraphina Graciani, a current student of the Academy, ends up working with him under the pretext of training, somewhat forcibly.
Together, they have solved small cases such as finding lost pets and investigating infidelities.

One day, Hayate receives a strange request from his former classmate Adele Forgan.

The request arises after her grandfather, the head of the Forgan family, falls gravely ill,
and her relatives begin dying under suspicious circumstances one after another.

Each of the deceased reportedly mentioned seeing "a woman in a red dress" just a few days before their deaths.

"You have to protect us.
Us three sisters. And I want you to uncover
the truth behind the curse—the Crimson Lady."

Curiosity piqued by Seraphina’s relentless urging and unable to refuse a request from an old friend, Hayate accepts the case.

The two are invited to the Forgan family mansion, where they begin tracing the shadow of the Crimson Lady.

"Well, I guess when a real big case actually shows up,
you think... this isn’t detective work at all."
"Yeah…"

[Translate from [url=https://crystalia.amusecraft.com/cratri/]official website[/url]]
translation:
在不久的将来，网络化已经司空见惯的时代，

主人公疾风如月毕业于以培养杰出人才着称的著名教育机构[Academy]，
尽管他以班级第一名的成绩毕业，而且对地位和名誉不感兴趣，但他在家乡经营着一家侦探社。

塞拉菲娜·格拉西亚尼（Seraphina Graciani）是学院的一名学生，最终以培训为借口与他一起工作，有些强迫。
他们一起解决了一些小案件，例如寻找丢失的宠物和调查不忠行为。

有一天，疾风收到了他以前的同学阿黛尔·福根的一个奇怪的请求。

这个请求是在她的祖父，福根家族的族长病重之后提出的，
她的亲人也开始陆续在可疑的情况下死亡。

据报道，每名死者都提到在死前几天看到“一名穿红裙子的女人”。

“你必须保护我们。
我们三姐妹。我想让你揭开
诅咒背后的真相——深红女士。”

塞拉菲娜的不断催促激起了他的好奇心，又无法拒绝老朋友的请求，旋风接受了这个案子。

两人被邀请前往福根家族宅邸，在那里他们开始追踪深红女士的影子。

“嗯，我想当一个真正的大案子真正出现时，
你认为……这根本不是侦探工作。”
“是啊……”

【翻译自[url=https://crystalia.amusecraft.com/cratri/]官网[/url]】
